import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long mo;
    static class ModInt {
        long v;
        ModInt(long a) {
            v = a;
            if (mo != 0 && (v >= mo || v < 0)) {
                v = (v % mo + mo) % mo;
            }
        }
        
        static ModInt pow(ModInt a, long n) {
            long b = a.v, r = 1;
            while (n > 0) {
                if (n % 2 == 1) {
                    r = (r * b) % mo;
                }
                b = (b * b) % mo;
                n >>= 1;
            }
            return new ModInt(r);
        }
        
        ModInt add(ModInt a) {
            v += a.v;
            if (v >= mo) v -= mo;
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt sub(ModInt a) {
            v = (v + mo - a.v) % mo;
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt mul(ModInt a) {
            v = (v * a.v) % mo;
            return this;
        }
        
        ModInt div(ModInt a) {
            if (a.v == 0) {
                throw new AssertionError("Division by zero");
            }
            return mul(pow(a, mo - 2));
        }
        
        ModInt addNew(ModInt a) {
            return new ModInt(this.v).add(a);
        }
        
        ModInt subNew(ModInt a) {
            return new ModInt(this.v).sub(a);
        }
        
        ModInt mulNew(ModInt a) {
            return new ModInt(this.v).mul(a);
        }
        
        ModInt divNew(ModInt a) {
            return new ModInt(this.v).div(a);
        }
    }
    
    static int N, M;
    static ModInt[] dp1 = new ModInt[505];
    static ModInt[] dp2 = new ModInt[505];
    static ModInt[][] dp3 = new ModInt[505][505];
    static ModInt[][] dp4 = new ModInt[505][505];
    
    static long[] fact = new long[400001];
    static long[] factr = new long[400001];
    static long[] inv = new long[400001];
    
    static long comb(int N_, int C_) {
        if (fact[0] == 0) {
            inv[1] = fact[0] = factr[0] = 1;
            for (int i = 2; i <= 400000; ++i) {
                inv[i] = inv[(int)(mo % i)] * (mo - mo / i) % mo;
            }
            for (int i = 1; i <= 400000; ++i) {
                fact[i] = fact[i-1] * i % mo;
                factr[i] = factr[i-1] * inv[i] % mo;
            }
        }
        if (C_ < 0 || C_ > N_) return 0;
        return factr[C_] * fact[N_] % mo * factr[N_ - C_] % mo;
    }
    
    static void solve() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextInt();
        M = sc.nextInt();
        mo = sc.nextLong();
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            dp1[i] = new ModInt(0);
            dp2[i] = new ModInt(0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= N; j++) {
                dp3[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
                dp4[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
            }
        }
        
        dp1[0] = new ModInt(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                ModInt term = new ModInt(i + 1).mulNew(dp1[j-1]).mulNew(dp1[i-j]).mulNew(new ModInt(comb(i-1, j-1)));
                dp1[i] = new ModInt(dp1[i].v).add(term);
                
                ModInt term2 = new ModInt(i + 1).mulNew(
                    dp2[i-j].mulNew(dp1[j-1]).addNew(dp1[i-j].mulNew(dp2[j-1]))
                ).mulNew(new ModInt(comb(i-1, j-1)));
                dp2[i] = new ModInt(dp2[i].v).add(term2);
                
                ModInt term3 = dp1[j-1].mulNew(dp1[i-j]).mulNew(new ModInt(comb(i-1, j-1)));
                long c1 = (long)(j-1) * (j) / 2;
                long c2 = (long)(i-j) * (i-j+1) / 2;
                dp2[i] = new ModInt(dp2[i].v).add(term3.mulNew(new ModInt(c1 + c2)));
            }
        }
        
        dp3[0][0] = new ModInt(1);
        for (int i = 1; i <= N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                dp3[i][j] = new ModInt(dp3[i-1][j].v);
                dp4[i][j] = new ModInt(dp4[i-1][j].v);
                for (int l = 1; l <= j; l++) {
                    ModInt term = dp1[l].mulNew(dp3[i-l-1][j-l]).mulNew(new ModInt(comb(j, l)));
                    dp3[i][j] = new ModInt(dp3[i][j].v).add(term);
                    
                    ModInt term2 = dp1[l].mulNew(dp4[i-l-1][j-l]).addNew(dp2[l].mulNew(dp3[i-l-1][j-l]));
                    term2 = term2.mulNew(new ModInt(comb(j, l)));
                    dp4[i][j] = new ModInt(dp4[i][j].v).add(term2);
                }
            }
            dp3[i][i] = new ModInt(dp1[i].v);
            dp4[i][i] = new ModInt(dp2[i].v);
        }
        
        System.out.println(dp4[N][M].v);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        solve();
    }
}
